name: Benefits — PAR DME rental: finish the deductible, then apply the coinsurance
description: Twenty guided steps built from the Benefits.6 story: price the line, work through the 5Ws of Benefit (the provider's specialty and participation, the procedure, the date of service, the claim type and place of service, the diagnosis) with Code Set lookups, find the Durable Medical Equipment → Lease/Rental service-level benefit for the PAR provider, check the out-of-pocket limits and the accumulators, calculate what the member owes, validate to apply the benefits and confirm them on Claim Lines, then pay the claim.

steps.name: Identify the allowed amount for the procedure
steps.description: Identify the allowed amount for the procedure. Open the Search tab, then the Pricing sub-tab, scroll down to the Claim lines section and click Get Pricing. The allowed amount then shows in the Allowed column. Review it together with the Billed amount (the bill charge) and the Write-off: the allowed amount is the bill charge less the write-off. For procedure E0601 the bill charge is $750.00, the allowed amount is $400.00 and the write-off is $350.00.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when Get Pricing is clicked in Search → Pricing.
steps.hint: Search tab → Pricing sub-tab → Claim lines → Get Pricing. Allowed = Billed − Write-off.
steps.checklistItem: Identify the allowed amount for the procedure

steps.name: Who — check the provider specialty
steps.description: Start the 5Ws of Benefit, which decide the right benefit for the claim. The first W is Who. Open the Provider Info tab and, in the Rendering section, read the Speciality and Speciality description fields: the provider's specialty is DURABLE MEDICAL EQUIPMENT & MEDICAL SUPPLIES (054).
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Provider Info tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Provider Info → Rendering → Speciality and Speciality description: DURABLE MEDICAL EQUIPMENT & MEDICAL SUPPLIES.

steps.name: Who — confirm provider participation
steps.description: Continue the Who review on the Claim Header tab. In the General Claim Data section, the Provider Participation field reads PAR: the provider participates in the network, so the PAR benefits apply.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Header tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Claim Header → General Claim Data → Provider Participation: PAR.

steps.name: What — identify the procedure code
steps.description: The next W is What. Open the Claim Lines tab and find the procedure code on line 1: E0601. You look it up in Code Set next. Also check Modifiers to determine rental or purchase benefits to apply, if RR - Rental, NU - Purchase. Here Modifiers is RR, so rental.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Lines tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Claim Lines → Line 1 → Procedure: E0601, Modifiers: RR (rental).

steps.name: What — review the procedure code details
steps.description: Look up the procedure code. Open the Search tab, then the Code Set sub-tab. Procedure Code (Px) is already selected in Select Code Type and E0601 is in Enter Code, with the search already performed. Note the description — CONTINUOUS POSITIVE AIRWAY PRESSURE (CPAP) DEVICE; — and the service classes 24 (PRIOR AUTH PASS) and 34 (DURABLE MEDICAL EQUIPMENT). Together they tell you the service billed: a CPAP device, which is durable medical equipment.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Search → Code Set sub-tab is opened while this step is active. Sub-tabs start closed, so the trainee opens it deliberately.
steps.hint: Search tab → Code Set sub-tab. The E0601 lookup is already shown.
steps.checklistItem: What — review the procedure code details

steps.name: When — note the date of service
steps.description: The next W is When. Go back to the Claim Lines tab and read the date of service on line 1 from its From date and To columns: 02/23/2026.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Lines tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Claim Lines → Line 1 → From date and To: 02/23/2026.
steps.checklistItem: When — note the date of service

steps.name: Where — check the claim type
steps.description: The next W is Where: where the service was performed. Start with the claim type. Open the Claim Data tab, then the Details sub-tab, and in the Additional Claim Data section read the Claim type field: PA - Professional.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Data → Details sub-tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Claim Data → Details → Additional Claim Data → Claim type: PA - Professional.

steps.name: Where — note the place of service
steps.description: Check the place of service on the claim. On the Claim Lines tab, the POS field on line 1 reads 12.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Lines tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Claim Lines → Line 1 → POS: 12.
steps.checklistItem: Where — note the place of service

steps.name: Where — confirm the POS description
steps.description: Look up the POS code. Open Search → Code Set and choose Place of Service (POS) in Select Code Type. Line 1's code, 12, fills in and its result shows straight away: the description is Home.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the POS 12 lookup is shown in Code Set — by choosing Place of Service (POS), or by searching that type for 12.
steps.hint: Search → Code Set → Select Code Type: Place of Service (POS). POS 12 is Home.

steps.name: Why — identify the diagnosis code
steps.description: The final W is Why. On the Claim Lines tab, find the diagnosis code on line 1: G4733.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Lines tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Claim Lines → Line 1 → Diagnosis: G4733.

steps.name: Why — review the diagnosis code details
steps.description: Look up the diagnosis code. Open Search → Code Set and choose Diagnosis Code (Dx - ICD-10) in Select Code Type. Line 1's diagnosis, G4733, fills in and the search is applied: the description is OBSTRUCTIVE SLEEP APNEA (ADULT) (PEDIATRIC), and the Limit class table lists M01 (MSSB - NERVOUS AND MENTAL) and U00 (SUTTER DX SLEEP STUDY).
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the G4733 lookup is shown in Code Set — by choosing Diagnosis Code (Dx - ICD-10), or by searching that type for G4733.
steps.hint: Search → Code Set → Select Code Type: Diagnosis Code (Dx - ICD-10).
steps.checklistItem: Why — review the diagnosis code details

steps.name: Open the benefits for the contract
steps.description: With the 5Ws complete — a durable medical equipment supplier that is PAR, procedure E0601 on 02/23/2026, a PA - Professional claim at POS 12 (Home), diagnosis G4733 — check the benefits that apply. Open the Search tab, then the Benefits sub-tab, and make sure the date of service, 02/23/2026, falls inside the contract's Effective date and End date (01/01/2026 – 12/31/9999).
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Search → Benefits sub-tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Search tab → Benefits sub-tab. 02/23/2026 falls inside 01/01/2026 – 12/31/9999.
steps.checklistItem: Open the benefits for the contract

steps.name: Locate the benefit category and subcategory
steps.description: Click + next to Service level to open the benefit categories, listed under a Benefits Category search box. Open the Benefit Hierarchy Service Categories Document to identify the Major Category and subcategory to select as per the Procedure details previously identified. From the details you noted, the major category is Durable Medical Equipment and the subcategory is Lease/Rental. The procedure decides the category: E0601 is a CPAP device, and its service class is 34 - DURABLE MEDICAL EQUIPMENT, so the benefit sits under Durable Medical Equipment. Expand Durable Medical Equipment with its arrow to show its subcategories, Lease/Rental, Purchase and Repair; for this claim the subcategory is Lease/Rental. Then expand Lease/Rental to show the additional categories beneath it: Blood Glucose Meter, Breast Pump, Chronic Renal Disease Equipment, Commode, CPAP, Hospital Bed, Humidifier, Infusion Pump, Insulin Pump, Lift, Suction Pump, Walker and Wheelchair, each split into New and Used. Check whether any of them carries a benefit of its own for this procedure. CPAP names this equipment, but it holds only New and Used and no benefit of its own, as View Benefits on it shows, and the same is true of every category beneath Lease/Rental. So Lease/Rental under Durable Medical Equipment is the benefit to use.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when Lease/Rental is expanded under Durable Medical Equipment. Expanding Durable Medical Equipment itself, or any other category, completes nothing.
steps.hint: Benefits sub-tab → + Service level → expand Durable Medical Equipment → expand Lease/Rental. Service class 34 - DURABLE MEDICAL EQUIPMENT picks the category; CPAP beneath Lease/Rental carries no benefit of its own.
steps.checklistItem: Locate the benefit category and subcategory

steps.name: Review the Lease Rental benefits for the PAR provider
steps.description: Click View Benefits on the same Lease/Rental row under Durable Medical Equipment. A dialog titled Service level opens and lists the place-of-service options. The POS you noted is 12 (Home), so locate the HOME options. HOME is listed three times, and two of those options carry a cost-share table. Open each HOME option's triangle and use the Network column to tell them apart: the option showing PAR is the benefit for this PAR provider. It shows an individual deductible of $3,000.00 (PINDED), a family deductible of $6,000.00 (PFMDED), coinsurance of 80.00%, and Y for the deductibles and coinsurance included in OOP, the adjudication indicator and the benefit covered indicator. The other option shows NPAR, with a $3,500.00 individual deductible and a $6,500.00 family deductible, and the third HOME option has no cost share details. So the member pays the $3,000.00 individual or the $6,000.00 family deductible, whichever is met first; after that the plan covers 80% of the allowed amount and the member pays 20% as coinsurance. Close the dialog.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the HOME option whose Network column reads PAR is opened. The NPAR option, the third HOME option and the other options complete nothing.
steps.hint: View Benefits on Durable Medical Equipment → Lease/Rental → open the HOME options → the one showing PAR is the benefit.
steps.checklistItem: Review the Lease Rental benefits for the PAR provider

steps.name: Review the Out-of-Pocket limits
steps.description: Click + next to Plan Level on the same Benefits sub-tab, then scroll to the Out-of-pocket table to check the out-of-pocket limits for this service. The provider is PAR, so read only the PAR rows: the individual OOP limit is $4,500.00 and the family OOP limit is $8,000.00 (the NPAR limits are $6,000.00 and $12,000.00). You already reviewed the deductible limits under the service-level benefit, so they need no second look.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when Plan Level is opened.
steps.hint: Benefits sub-tab → + Plan Level → Out-of-pocket: PAR $4,500.00 individual, $8,000.00 family.

steps.name: Review the accrued deductible
steps.description: Now check how much of the deductible and OOP limits the member has already accrued. In the Accumulators section of the same sub-tab, open the DEDUCTIBLE group. For the benefit year 01/01/2026 – 12/31/2026 it shows INDIVIDUAL DED PAR 2950.00, INDIVIDUAL DED NONPAR 1392.87, FAMILY DEDUCTIBLE PAR 5800.00 and FAMILY DEDUCTIBLE NONPAR 2380.51. The provider is PAR, so only the PAR rows apply.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the DEDUCTIBLE accumulator group is expanded.
steps.hint: Benefits sub-tab → Accumulators → DEDUCTIBLE. PAR: individual 2950.00, family 5800.00.

steps.name: Review the accrued Out-of-Pocket
steps.description: Open the OUT OF POCKET group in the Accumulators section. For the same period it shows INDIVIDUAL OOP PAR 3500.00, INDIVIDUAL OOP NONPAR 1392.87, FAMILY OOP PAR 5500.00 and FAMILY OOP NONPAR 2380.51. Again, only the PAR rows apply.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the OUT OF POCKET accumulator group is expanded.
steps.hint: Benefits sub-tab → Accumulators → OUT OF POCKET. PAR: individual 3500.00, family 5500.00.

steps.name: Calculate the benefits to apply
steps.description: Summarise what you found and work out the benefits for line 1, then open the Claim Lines tab, where they will be applied. Claim: bill charge $750.00, allowed $400.00, write-off $350.00. Benefits: individual deductible $3,000.00, family deductible $6,000.00, coinsurance 80%. OOP limits: individual $4,500.00, family $8,000.00. Accrued: individual deductible 2950.00, family deductible 5800.00, individual OOP 3500.00, family OOP 5500.00. Remaining deductible: individual $3,000.00 − 2950.00 = $50.00; family $6,000.00 − 5800.00 = $200.00. Remaining OOP: individual $4,500.00 − 3500.00 = $1,000.00; family $8,000.00 − 5500.00 = $2,500.00. The deductible comes first: the member still owes $50.00 toward the individual deductible, the smaller of the two remainders, so $50.00 of the allowed amount is applied as deductible, and the individual deductible is then met. The coinsurance applies to what is left: the remaining $350.00 ($400.00 − $50.00) is split per the benefit, so the plan covers 80% and the member pays 20% as coinsurance, $70.00. The member's share on this line, $50.00 + $70.00 = $120.00, is well within the $1,000.00 of individual OOP remaining, so the out-of-pocket maximum caps nothing. That leaves $400.00 − $50.00 − $70.00 = $280.00 paid on this claim. The write-off, the deductible and the coinsurance are updated on line 1, each with its EOB code: PX_00066 for the $350.00 write-off, PX_00038 for the $50.00 deductible and PX_00067 for the $70.00 coinsurance.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Lines tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: $50.00 finishes the individual deductible, and 20% of the remaining $350.00 is $70.00 coinsurance: EOB PX_00066 for the $350.00 write-off, PX_00038 for the $50.00 deductible, PX_00067 for the $70.00 coinsurance, and $280.00 paid.

steps.name: Validate and confirm the applied benefits
steps.description: With the amounts worked out, click the Validate button on the claim summary. The system then applies the benefits to the claim automatically, and the values change on the Claim Lines tab you are already on. Check that the amounts and EOB codes Validate applied match your calculation: Line 1 — Benefits now shows EOB PX_00066 with a write-off of $350.00, EOB PX_00038 with a deductible of $50.00, EOB PX_00067 with a coinsurance of $70.00, no copay EOB, $280.00 paid, and the Benefit rule DMERENTAL - LEASERENTAL. These values appear only after Validate.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when Validate is clicked on the claim summary bar.
steps.hint: Validate sits on the claim summary bar, next to Submit. Then read Line 1 — Benefits on the Claim Lines tab.
steps.checklistItem: Validate and confirm the applied amounts and EOB codes
steps.completionToast: Benefits applied to line 1 — write-off, deductible and coinsurance posted, balance paid.

steps.name: Submit Pay decision
steps.description: Once the benefits are applied and confirmed, pay the claim. Choose Pay from the Action menu in the header, then click Submit on the claim summary bar.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Pay decision is submitted.
steps.hint: Choose 'Pay' from the Action menu in the header, then click Submit.
